newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - private.

text.p: Trade in Nebraska feedlot cattle was at a standstill Thursday with most of the week's showlist already sold out, market sources said.
"There just isn't anything left to trade," one source said, noting sales this week already stand at around 95,000 head versus a showlist of about 85,000.
There were a few offers at $108 and $109 per cwt, dressed, versus light trade on Wednesday at $106 and $107. No bids were reported on a live or dressed basis.
